variant.description: hooks module under phasevae.variants that owns the model; base is tutorial 7 (encoder-deployed, no conditional prior). A new recipe is a new module plus a new config, never a flag in run.py.

emission.description: p(y | phi) shape. cosine is the tutorial's own a + b cos(phi); triangle is the champion deviation; transformer is the learned emission (seed lottery, see phasevae-family-verdict).

emission_layers.description: transformer emission only: number of attention layers. Ignored by the closed-form emissions.

emission_positional.description: transformer emission only: add positional encoding, letting the emission read FRAME INDEX as well as phase.

drift_bound.description: structured q: mu = offset + cumsum(delta + eps * tanh(g)), with eps bounded by this. 0 pins the trajectory to the given bar rate (no drift channel at all).

bar_rate.description: ONE drift per bar-length segment instead of one per frame; needs drift_bound > 0 to do anything.

epochs.description: training epochs; one fresh window per song per epoch.

batch_size.description: windows per step, shared by training and evaluation.

lr.description: Adam learning rate for the single base parameter group.

clip.description: gradient-norm clip over the params the variant's optimizer hook hands back.

samples.description: posterior samples per window in the reconstruction term.

pos_weight.description: positive-class weight in the Bernoulli reconstruction. Anything but 1 is a surrogate, not an ELBO.

beta_end.description: KL weight after warmup; the reported elbo is always beta = 1.

beta_warmup.description: epochs to ramp beta linearly from beta_start to beta_end; 0 disables annealing.

emission_sharpness.description: scheduled floor on the emission amplitude b (closed-form emissions only); 0 leaves b free.

sharpness_warmup.description: epochs over which the emission_sharpness floor ramps in.

excerpt_seconds.description: window length. Below ~45 s the ELBO cannot separate tracking the truth from coasting on a constant period (crop-horizon root cause).

kappa_physical.description: concentration of the physical prior's increment law: the DRIFT TAX. Real tempo wobble is heavy-tailed, so lowering this cuts the KL price of expressing drift.

frontend.description: module under phasevae.data.frontends supplying features + activations. The frontend is part of the model, not preprocessing (see phasevae-checkpoint-artifact).

frontend_checkpoint.description: checkpoint the frontend loads; ONE serves train/val/test alike. final0 is Beat This's (gtzan held out of every checkpoint); beat_transformer wants e.g. fold_0.

frontend_lr_scale.description: multiplier on lr for the frontend's own parameters. 0 = frozen (the frontend runs under no_grad and only the VAE trains); > 0 thaws it and adds it as a second optimizer group at lr * this.
